description: Drive a browser you are already signed into, or a standalone automation browser.
name: io.github.t3ratech/mcp-session-bridge

environmentVariables.description: auto (default) uses the extension when its relay socket exists and falls back to a standalone browser; extension forces the extension; standalone forces its own browser.
environmentVariables.name: T3RNEL_SESSION_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run the standalone browser headless. Ignored in extension mode.
environmentVariables.name: T3RNEL_SESSION_HEADLESS

environmentVariables.description: How long a single tool call may take before it fails rather than hanging the client.
environmentVariables.name: T3RNEL_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS
